subject.title: feat: add daily change history for config collection

question: Should `mongodata.config_historic` snapshot every `config` document that may contain credentials, and if so what retention or access boundary should it enforce?
rationale: The PR intentionally expands current-secret mirroring into historical retention of rotated credential values, which is a security/data-governance choice rather than a purely mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Limit or expire secret history
options.body: Keep the history feature but exclude known credential documents or add explicit partition expiration/access controls before merge.

options.title: Approve full credential history
options.body: Merge full-collection history only if maintainers intentionally accept historical retention under the existing BigQuery access boundary.

options.title: Split mirror fix from history
options.body: Merge only the `MERGE_COLLECTIONS` repair now and revisit historical config snapshots in a separate security-reviewed PR.

recommendation.title: Limit or expire secret history
recommendation.body: Keep the history feature but exclude known credential documents or add explicit partition expiration/access controls before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion already routes this sensitive data-platform review to MiguelHamelyn.
